description: Send short feedback to the voicehook team about these tools: kind bug (something is broken), unclear (a description or result is confusing) or wish (something is missing). No session needed. text: max 1000 characters; keys, tokens, invite links and email addresses are masked before storing. Never include the user's content, invite links, keys or emails. Stored: kind, text, client name and version, time. Returns {status: stored, masked}; masked = true means something was masked. Errors: 422 = unknown kind or text too long, 429 = too many reports from this client right now.

text.description: What happened or what is missing, max 1000 chars.
